warnings: Frames senza righe traccia palla indicano assenza di osservazione/predizione, non prova di ace o fine copertura.

proposal_grouping.method: heuristic: same tracked player across raw classes, split on detection gaps and confidence peaks
proposal_grouping.simultaneous_player_isolation: separate groups for distinct player track IDs
proposal_grouping.peak_prominence_definition: minimum confidence drop to adjacent local-peak valley or run edge; highest peak always retained
proposal_grouping.group_boundary: midpoint in time between retained peaks
proposal_grouping.event_frame_selection: maximum confidence inside each group; ties use earliest time then lowest detection ID; event frame can differ from seed peak
proposal_grouping.limitations: estimated events, not verified contacts: close touches on one track can merge when peaks are less than the minimum distance or lack a confidence valley; trackless groups remain class/episode-specific to avoid unsafe spatial merging

embedding_status: Per-detection pre-classifier features at retained NMS anchor; 121/121 vectors present; dimension=192; no reduction applied.
embedding_feature_source: input to final convolution of the winning class head at the NMS-selected anchor
proposal_probability_source: raw six-class sigmoid scores normalized to sum one; no contextual sequence correction
conf_tocco_source: peak-frame YOLO winning-class confidence; not a calibrated event/contact probability
team_source: not inferable from geometric tracker side; exported blank
ball_coordinates_source: same-frame observed ball pixel only, nearest to gesture-box center within 120px; projected with the confirmed image-to-court homography
ball_coordinates_projection_caveat: homography intersects the observed image ray with the court plane; for a ball in flight this is an estimate, not a measured physical ground position
